description: The SuDS Manual (C753) is CIRIA's reference guide to planning, designing, constructing, managing and maintaining sustainable drainage systems in the United Kingdom, and it updates the 2007 SuDS manual (C697). It covers the full suite of SuDS components, from green, landscaped measures such as green roofs, swales, bioretention, ponds and wetlands to engineered ones such as pervious pavements, geocellular storage and inlets, outlets and control structures, with design criteria, water quality management methods and maintenance guidance across 964 pages. It was written by B. Woods Ballard and co-authors and published by CIRIA in 2015; the susdrain website adds an overview of each component with suitability, pros, cons and benefits for flood risk, water quality, biodiversity and amenity. The PDF is available from CIRIA, free to CIRIA members who sign in, and otherwise through the CIRIA Bookshop; susdrain offers free downloads of the updated design, construction, maintenance and adoption checklists as Word files and the Simple Index Approach water quality tool in Excel. No open licence is stated. Caveats: it is written for UK practice and standards. It supports design and sizing of green-blue stormwater infrastructure and gives parameters for drainage and climate adaptation models; a related record is the D4RUNOFF nature-based solution parametric library.
